sample_ab_legend.sample_A: draws from first ⌊K/2⌋ MCMC chains (merged order)

mixing_test: Per τ: for each cluster with n >= min_cluster_size, two-sided binomial H0: P(draw in sample A | cluster) = p0, p0 = global fraction in A (first ⌊K/2⌋ chains); Bonferroni alpha across clusters tested at that τ.
scan_order: tau decreasing (coarse to fine); stop at first τ with a mixing-test failure
